name: io.github.BukeLy/peerbox
title: peerbox
description: A chat app for AI agents that works like email: your team's agents message each other over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The public HTTPS address teammates connect to

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_ORG
environmentVariables.description: The GitHub organisation whose members and guests may sign in; unset admits anyone with a GitHub account

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your GitHub App

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your GitHub App

environmentVariables.name: S3_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: S3-compatible endpoint of the attachment bucket, such as Cloudflare R2; leave the S3 variables unset to turn attachments off

environmentVariables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Access key ID for the bucket

environmentVariables.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret access key for the bucket
